plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: I wanted three things the library does not give at a plan price. (1) C5: a check that the worker's reads were only of approved customers. Scope of a call can only be named on lines of the record, at 10 per line, and the 101 reads would cost 1010 against an allowance of 50. (2) C10: a check that every sending call left its row in the outbox. Trace of a call is likewise named-lines only, at 100 lines costing 1000, so only about 5 lines are affordable. (3) C3: a check that each case category follows the requester's rule. No instrument in the library reads categories against a rule. Sent as released reads the record, not the outbox, so C10 stays not shown after A3. C5 and C10 can only be partly covered by sampling named lines from the allowance during the work. C3 cannot be shown by any instrument in hand.
